message.content:
In French, “hello” can be expressed mainly as **“bonjour.”**  
It literally translates to *good morning/afternoon* and is the standard polite greeting you’ll hear everywhere in France (and other Francophone regions).  

A more informal, casual way people say hello among friends is **“salut,”** which works similarly to English’s “hi.”

So:
| English | Common French |
|---------|---------------|
| Hello   | bonjour / salut |

Use « bonjour » when speaking formally or with strangers, and « salut » for relaxed conversations.
